params.name: force-cpu
params.description: Override QEMU's -cpu argument with the given string.

aw-bits.description: Specifies the vIOMMU address space bit width.
aw-bits.verbose_description:
Specifies the vIOMMU address space bit width.

Intel vIOMMU supports a bit width of either 39 or 48 bits and VirtIO vIOMMU supports any bit width between 32 and 64 bits.

enable-s3.description: Enables S3 power state. Defaults to false beginning with machine types 9.2+pve1, true before.

enable-s4.description: Enables S4 power state. Defaults to false beginning with machine types 9.2+pve1, true before.

viommu.description: Enable and set guest vIOMMU variant (Intel vIOMMU needs q35 to be set as machine type).

params.name: migration_network
params.description: CIDR of the (sub) network that is used for migration.

params.name: migration_type
params.description: Migration traffic is encrypted using an SSH tunnel by default. On secure, completely private networks this can be disabled to increase performance.

params.name: nets-host-mtu
params.description: Used for migration compat. List of VirtIO network devices and their effective host_mtu setting according to the QEMU object model on the source side of the migration. A value of 0 means that the host_mtu parameter is to be avoided for the corresponding device.

params.name: skiplock
params.description: Ignore locks - only root is allowed to use this option.

params.name: stateuri
params.description: Some command save/restore state from this location.

params.name: targetstorage
params.description: Mapping from source to target storages. Providing only a single storage ID maps all source storages to that storage. Providing the special value '1' will map each source storage to itself.

params.name: with-conntrack-state
params.description: Whether to migrate conntrack entries for running VMs.
